facts.fact: The Ministry of Health and Population said the health minister discussed a proposed 'Egypt Smart Healthcare Platform' with MTS and Inspur, to hold unified patient health records shared between facilities, and discussed launching a pilot for its first phase; it is a proposal, with no timetable given (reported 14 September 2026).

Officials reviewed proposed financing models for the Egypt Smart Healthcare Platform, but the health ministry disclosed neither its expected cost nor the financing arrangements (reported 14 September 2026).

systems.owner: Ministry of Health and Population (proposed; discussed with MTS and Inspur)
systems.tiers: Proposed only: to connect health facilities through a unified network; no tiers stated
